title: Non-minimal Unimodular Inflation
summary: We study an extension of the unimodular cosmological inflation in the context of the non-minimal coupling of a generic scalar field with gravitational sector. We consider the non-minimal coupling of the scalar field and gravity as the only source of energy-momentum tensor in this setup. Without introducing new particles other than those already existing in electroweak theory, the generic scalar field's non-minimal coupling is responsible for the generation of the seeds of perturbations for structure formation and the observed Cosmic Microwave Background anisotropies in this scenario.
